reviewed_by: Claude Code, implementing the operator's request to hold individual chats when research priorities shift
reason: A project hold froze a whole project, including new work. A ProjectHold can now name one chat (session_id) and covers that chat plus its subagent and goal-child chats, never forks or later chats. Holds placed together share a batch_id. Every hold gate that knows the chat (provider and harness turn creation, resume, callbacks, restart resume, parked restore, schedules, follow-up queue, subagent parent wake, goal start/resume, Mission approval resume and delegated synthesis) now passes it. Goal pause marks children before parents so release restores both; a goal released while another hold still covers it moves to that hold. New routes POST engagements/{id}/holds, holds/release and GET chat-sessions/{id}/hold. Interactive Butler gets nebula.work.holds, hold_chats, release_chats, hold_project, release_project with no confirmation; background Butler is refused. Selected: test_chat_holds.py (new: scoping, coverage, child goals, all_active, partial release, mark hand-off, turn stops, authenticated routes, Butler tools, background refusal), test_project_holds.py (existing project-hold contract), test_control_assistant_work.py (work tool registry) and the scheduled-Butler catalog test that enumerates every work action. The Butler board now marks each card whose chat is on a chat hold with that hold (id, batch, reason), so the UI can group held chats by batch; test_butler_goal_chat_proposals.py covers the board.
exclusions: No UI change in this PR (the board, chat menu and Release and send come with the UI PR), so no frontend or Playwright tests. test_butler_capabilities.py::test_scheduled_butler_can_edit_all_assistant_settings and two test_settings_assistant_tools.py tests fail identically on origin/main and are not selected. The product knowledge index does not read docs/design/project-holds.md.
